reason: I cut the hair myself in a one or two chair shop and I write every bill in my register, I know every customer by face. Paying ₹4,999 plus ₹999 every month for staff selfies and dashboards I don't need, when my register has never let me down, makes no sense.
objection: My register works and costs nothing. With one helper at most, I can see the chair and the cash drawer myself, so the app is solving a problem I don't have, and ₹999 a month every month adds up to a lot from my earnings.
would_change_my_mind: If it were only the WhatsApp due-back reminders for my regular customers, very simple, with no setup fee and under ₹200 a month, and my distributor or a fellow shop owner showed me it bringing customers back.
